description.subtitle: Adidas children's training sweatshirt from Juventus 2025 2025 - black and white
description.tagline: Train with the spirit of the Vecchia Signora
description.intro: This adidas training sweatshirt from the Juventus for children offers comfort and professional style inspired by the colors of the club. Perfect for young people who want to train like their idols, with technical fabric and youthful fit.
key_benefits: Official design: Inspired by Juventus training clothes.
Thermal comfort: Soft fabric ideal for keeping the heat during training.
Freedom of movement: Optimised cut for growing players.
Identidad del club: Escudo visible y detalles adidas en ambas piezas.
Complete set: Jacket with zipper and pants with elastic waist.
